title: FHIR upload rejects valid collection bundle
body: Our data reviewer uploaded a valid R4 collection Bundle containing Patient, Condition, Observation, Encounter, MedicationRequest, and AllergyIntolerance resources. ClinSight returned an invalid bundle error even though the same JSON validates in our FHIR tooling.

title: Patient import fails when Patient is not first
body: A hospital export places Encounter entries before the Patient entry. The upload finishes with 'No Patient resource found' even though a Patient resource is present later in the Bundle.

title: Re-upload removes previously imported chart records
body: We re-uploaded an updated Bundle for an existing FHIR patient containing only a new lab result. The older medications and encounters disappeared from the longitudinal chart after the update.

title: Observation valueCodeableConcept is blank
body: An Observation that uses valueCodeableConcept imports successfully, but its result is empty on the patient timeline. Quantity and string observations from the same Bundle display correctly.

title: Multiple patients in one Bundle are merged
body: We uploaded a transaction Bundle containing two Patient resources and observations for both. ClinSight created one patient and attached records from the second patient to the first chart.

title: Patient search misses family name
body: Searching the directory for a patient's family name returns no results, while entering the full display name finds the chart. This is affecting care coordinators who normally search by surname.

title: Patient list does not refresh after import
body: The FHIR upload reports a successful patient creation, but the new patient does not appear in the directory until the entire browser page is refreshed.

title: Search results show duplicate patient cards
body: After importing the same patient from a local Bundle and SMART Health IT, the patient directory shows two nearly identical records with the same name and date of birth.

title: Opening patient from search returns not found
body: A patient appears in directory search, but selecting the result opens a Patient not found response. Returning to the directory still shows the same result.

title: Directory search resets while typing
body: The patient search field clears and reloads the full directory after each refresh. It is difficult to enter a complete name on a slower connection.

title: SMART patient search times out
body: Searching the SMART Health IT sandbox by name spins for about 20 seconds and then shows a generic import error. Local FHIR uploads continue to work.

title: SMART import misses medication records
body: A patient in the SMART sandbox has active MedicationRequest resources, but the imported ClinSight chart shows zero medications while conditions and encounters are present.

title: SMART import creates duplicate patient on retry
body: The first external import appeared to time out, so we clicked Import again. Two patient entries were created for the same SMART patient identifier.

title: External FHIR search cannot find exact patient ID
body: Pasting a known SMART patient ID into the external search returns no matches because the panel appears to search only by patient name.

title: SMART allergy data is incomplete
body: The source sandbox shows several AllergyIntolerance records, but only one allergy appears after external import. We need to know whether the 100-resource query limit truncated the patient bundle.

title: Summary claim has no citation chip
body: The grounded patient summary states that hypertension is active, but no source citation is displayed below that claim. Other claims on the same chart include clickable citation chips.

title: Citation opens wrong source record
body: Selecting the citation for the latest A1c result shows metadata for a different Observation. The value in the summary is correct, but the cited record ID does not match it.

title: Grounding score stays at zero
body: A patient has conditions, observations, encounters, medications, and allergies with citations throughout the summary. The evaluation panel still reports zero source coverage and zero grounded claims.

title: Resolved condition described as active
body: The AI summary lists a resolved diabetes condition as active even though the condition status and chart timeline both show resolved.

title: Summary does not update after chart re-import
body: We corrected a blood pressure result and re-imported the patient Bundle. The timeline shows the new value, but the grounded summary continues to display the previous reading.

title: Chart assistant gives no answer for A1c
body: Asking 'Has this patient had an A1c recently?' returns insufficient evidence even though the timeline contains a recent Hemoglobin A1c Observation with a citation.

title: Assistant cites another patient's record
body: The chart assistant answer for one patient includes a citation ID that belongs to a different patient's Observation. This is a serious patient-data isolation concern.

title: Treatment request is not refused
body: We asked the assistant whether to increase a patient's medication dose. It returned a direct dosing suggestion instead of the expected safety refusal.

title: Assistant repeats old question after navigation
body: After asking about medications, we opened another patient and asked about allergies. The response repeated the previous medication answer and citations.

title: Assistant response loses source metadata
body: A data reviewer can see source system and batch information elsewhere on the chart, but citations returned by the patient assistant omit all source metadata.

title: Clinician can access admin audit page
body: A user signed in with the clinician demo role can open the audit URL directly and view ingestion and patient access events that should be restricted to administrators.

title: Care coordinator sees hidden source metadata
body: The care coordinator role displays source system, raw record ID, and ingestion batch identifiers on patient citation chips despite not having source metadata permission.

title: Expired session redirects in a loop
body: After leaving a patient chart open until the token expires, refreshing alternates between the login page and patient page without allowing a new sign-in.

title: Inactive user token still works
body: We marked a demo user inactive in the database, but their existing browser session can continue opening patient charts and requesting AI insights.

title: Data reviewer can upload but cannot view result
body: The data reviewer role successfully imports a FHIR Bundle, then receives an authorization error when opening the patient chart linked in the upload confirmation.

title: Patient chart access missing from audit log
body: A clinician opened several patient charts, but the audit page contains only login events. There are no patient_chart_access entries for those views.

title: Audit log shows wrong username
body: Patient access events performed by the care coordinator are attributed to the admin user in the audit trail.

title: Audit timestamps use inconsistent timezone
body: Login events appear in local time while ingestion and AI insight events appear in UTC. The sequence is misleading during incident review.

title: Audit page becomes unusable with many events
body: After generating several thousand patient access events, the audit page takes over a minute to load and renders every metadata block at once.

title: Failed external import has no audit event
body: A SMART FHIR import failed after the patient resource was fetched. The audit trail contains no failure event or remote patient identifier for investigation.

title: Diabetes care gap shown despite recent A1c
body: The chart has an A1c Observation from last month, but the care-gap panel still recommends reviewing A1c monitoring.

title: Hypertension gap misses systolic observation
body: A hypertensive patient has no blood pressure panel but does have recent systolic and diastolic Observations. ClinSight reports that no blood pressure data exists.

title: Duplicate lab inconsistency is not detected
body: Two Observations have the same code and effective date but different values. The inconsistency panel says no conflicts were found.

title: Encounter date warning uses valid overnight visit
body: An emergency encounter starts before midnight and ends the next morning, but it is flagged as having an end time before its start time.

title: No-allergy warning ignores documented NKDA
body: The patient has a confirmed No Known Drug Allergies record, yet the quality panel reports missing allergy documentation and creates a care gap.

title: dbt run duplicates curated patients
body: Running the same pipeline batch twice creates duplicate rows in the clinical patients mart even though the batch ID and source identifiers are unchanged.

title: Generated FHIR loses department and provider context
body: The raw hospital encounter includes department and provider identifiers, but the generated FHIR Bundle and imported patient chart contain neither field.

title: Pipeline rerun deletes another batch
body: Rerunning the synthetic generator with one ingestion batch ID removed raw encounter and lab rows belonging to a different batch.

title: dbt staging test fails on blank patient IDs
body: The generated raw dataset contains patient rows with empty source patient identifiers, causing uniqueness and not-null tests in staging to fail.

title: FHIR generator ignores configured limit
body: We set FHIR_LIMIT to 25, but the generator wrote substantially more than 25 patient Bundle files and exhausted the CI workspace.

title: Allergy popover is clipped
body: A patient with five allergies shows the +2 more button, but the hover popover is cut off by the patient header and the hidden allergies cannot be read.

title: Timeline events appear out of chronological order
body: Recent lab Observations are displayed below older encounters, and records without dates appear between dated clinical events.

title: Patient chart overflows on tablet
body: On a tablet-width screen the care-gap and inconsistency panels force the page wider than the viewport, requiring horizontal scrolling to read the chart.

title: Citation tooltip cannot be opened by keyboard
body: Mouse users can hover citation chips to see source excerpts, but keyboard users receive no visible tooltip when a citation receives focus.

title: Long medication name breaks timeline card
body: A MedicationRequest with a long compounded medication display name extends beyond its timeline card and covers the source metadata on the right.

title: Office printer jams on legal paper
body: The third-floor printer jams whenever legal-size paper is selected. Standard letter pages print normally, and this does not involve the ClinSight application.

title: Parking badge does not open west garage
body: My employee parking badge stopped opening the west garage gate this morning, although it still works at the main building entrance.

title: Cafeteria menu shows yesterday's lunch
body: The digital cafeteria board is still displaying yesterday's menu and prices. The clinical systems and patient workstations appear unaffected.

title: Payroll deposit amount is incorrect
body: My latest payroll deposit is missing the weekend shift differential. I need the payroll team to review the pay statement.

title: Conference room camera will not turn on
body: The USB camera in conference room B remains powered off during video calls, even after reconnecting the cable and restarting the room computer.

title: Vending machine charged without dispensing
body: The lobby vending machine charged my card for a bottle of water but did not dispense the item or offer a refund.

title: Shipping label prints with wrong address
body: A supply shipment label contains our previous warehouse address. This request is for the facilities shipping system, not a patient record or FHIR import.

title: Desk chair height adjustment is broken
body: The chair at workstation 4C sinks to its lowest position after a few minutes and needs repair or replacement.
